text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With today, summer training camp comes to 
an end. The Umamusume board the bus once 
again and head back to Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Your next entry is in a GII race, 
correct? I look forward to seeing your 
gallant performance."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I won't lose to the Central 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi's true grit—I will show it to 
you without fail.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank you for taking care of me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for teaching so, so many 
things to an inexperienced Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And you know, to pay back for helping me 
out this time, if Espo-san ever gets into 
trouble—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, but I ain't ever gonna become 
some weak Umamusume who needs saving.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Just as I always have. And always will, 
forever.
